name: deep-code-review
description: Five-lane deep code and isolated GitHub PR reviews with Tracker context and Matt Pocock's checks.

interface.shortDescription: Deep code and isolated GitHub PR reviews.
interface.longDescription: Provides two workflows: deep review of local changes and isolated GitHub PR or branch review. Requires Git; an authenticated GitHub CLI is recommended for complete PR context, with a git-only fallback when it is unavailable. Matt Pocock's code-review checks and both review skills are bundled. Yandex Tracker context is optional. Every non-trivial review runs five subagent lanes in 3+2 batches and reports stable finding IDs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $deep-code-review for local changes, or $github-pr-worktree-review for a GitHub PR or remote branch.
